# Support Handbook

Welcome to the support handbook. It explains how tickets move through the team.

## Refunds

Refunds are issued within thirty days of purchase. The customer must provide the order number and the reason for the return. Refunds go back to the original payment method and normally arrive within five working days.

### Partial refunds

A partial refund is possible when only part of an order is returned.

### Disputed charges

Disputed charges are handled by Billing, never by Support.

```sh
# this is a comment inside a fence, not a header
billing dispute --order 1234
```

## Escalation

If a ticket is not resolved in two days it is escalated to the duty manager. The duty manager reads the whole history before replying, so keep notes short and factual.

#hashtag is not a header.
